programmes.d: Unable to sleep, Alan goes for a jog on the beach. After his run takes a disastrous turn, Alan turns to a psychiatrist to discover the source of his insomnia.
During a double date, Charlie becomes annoyed with Alan for constantly borrowing money and promising to pay the tab "next time."
Charlie must choose between his girlfriend, Lydia, and Berta as they fight for his allegiance, each thinking the other has crossed the line.
As Charlie prepares for a Christmas Eve alone with his date, his friends and family keep dropping in--and staying--until Charlie is hosting an unplanned, unwanted holiday party.
When Berta discovers that Alan has been secretly dating her daughter, Naomi, Alan expects trouble. But Berta's reaction is surprising—and much worse—than Alan could have imagined.
Andi hires a pretty, young babysitter, Sophia (Victoria Justice), to watch the kids, and gets jealous when her daughter, Kate, goes to her instead for advice.
When Adam discovers that the pastor he hired for their wedding was a phony and he and Andi aren't really married, he scrambles to find a way to fix it before she finds out.
When the kids won't do their chores, Adam and Andi decide to go on strike too.
When Adam thinks Kate's boyfriend, Tyler (Griffin Gluck), is a pothead, he decides to confront Tyler but doesn't get the support he expects from Andi.
When Adam needs to hire a new project manager, Andi accuses Adam of unconscious bias after he only interviews men for the job.
Adam and Andi try to get back in their neighbors' good graces after no one shows up to their potluck.
When Adam and Andi are caught off guard by unexpected expenses, they each decide to give up a luxury to pay them off.
When Adam takes his kids to work with him for the day, they accidentally give his biggest client lice. Also, Andi feels like a bad mom when she's the only one in the family not to get lice.
When Adam notices his Dad's increasingly forgetful behavior, he struggles with how to approach him to discuss it.
When Adam and Andi agree on a present-free Valentine's Day, Adam gives the gift he planned for Andi to his mother instead.
Doug and Carrie hire Steve and his group of Russian mold employees to repair their damage, but it takes much longer and costs more than they expected.
On Valentine's Day, Carrie has to cancel dinner with Doug because he and Deacon have to deliver 2 penguins to Albany.
Doug and Carrie pick up some of their photos, but soon they find out, it's not their photos, but photos of another couple.
Doug doesn't want to go to the opera.

Doug finds out that Arthur owns inherited property where there is a house built, but there's just one problem, it's co-owned by his hated half-brother, Skitch. Doug attempts to reunite the brothers in an attempt to have Arthur move out.

After Danny gets a job working at IPS with Doug, he is able to do Doug's route faster than Doug can. Holly makes the mistake of giving Arthur a mini-trophy that says 'World's Best Grandfather', because Arthur would rather be more like a father to her.
Carrie discovers a 'loop hole' in the system, where she has up to 30 days to return items she purchases. Soon, it gets out of hand and she fills up her entire office with a temporary wardrobe.
After their bed breaks and Doug and Carrie are temporarily sleeping in separate beds, they start to like the idea of doing things alone.
Doug has Arthur get things from Carrie.
After a visit at his parents' house, Doug finds out that his dog has died and been replaced 3 times. Plus, Doug is informed by his parents that he was born in Montreal, Quebec.
Joe and Helen have to explain how they torched Brian's house. An insurance investigatoris suspicious of the whole scenario.
Joe and Helen learn to deal with their "overly neighborly" neighbors.
Joe and Helen find themselves celebrating their first year anniversary at a "SinglesMingle."
The suicide hotline proves to be good for Antonio. Helen competes with a gourmet foodcart
When a passenger leaves a cooler containing "The Gift of Life" in the terminal, the gangfeels responsible to return it.
When Sandpiper's plane is repossessed, Joe and Brian must sell the airline.
Sandpiper Air begins to fly for a country music tour. When the tour falls apart, the newowner disappears.
The real reason Clayton Industries purchased Sandpiper is revealed.

Joe and Helen's sex life gets wrapped into Roy's relationship with a TV talk show host.
Antonio is depressed that he is destined to be alone, so Joe and Brian unknowingly arrange a date with a prostitute.
Joe and Helen meet the famous architect Y.M. Burg, who out of sympathy offers to design their new traditional dream home. Brian hires a new mechanic with a secret.

Brian gains over a hundred pounds and is forced to join Eat-A-Holics, where he realizes that his outrageous weight gain is because he feels rejected by his recently married brother, Joe, now that Joe has less time to spend with him.
Helen and Joe fight over the plans for their new home and Joe has a terrible dream that seems like reality.
When the DMV tells Carrie that she has to wear corrective lenses in order to drive, Doug decides that he has finally found the perfect birthday present for her - laser eye surgery.
Doug and Carrie decide to try again to make a baby but are finding it hard to carve out any personal time with Arthur always under foot.
Doug rear-ends Kelly and Deacon's car and he and Carrie insist that they personally pay for the damage so they can leave the insurance company out of it.
As Doug is about to break what was once thought of as an unbeatable record, the tension between he and the guys at IPS mounts
When the kids won't admit who put a hole in the wall, Adam and Andi team up to get the culprit to confess.
When a blizzard prevents the Burns family from visiting the grandparents' house for Christmas, Adam and Andi scramble to avoid an epic holiday disaster.
When Adam's oldest daughter experiences a momentous occasion while Andi is unavailable, he tries to keep his cool and gingerly guide her through it.
Adam tries to pretend he isn't jealous when he discovers Andi has a close male friend at work.
Jake tells Charlie and Alan that he often overhears Judith and her fiancé, Herb, having sex, and he formulates a theory as to why his mom constantly gives Herb directions in bed.
